A) The answer is 1200.
B) The answer is 1000.
C) The answer is 1400.
D) The answer is 980.

2. Subtract the number of defective widgets from the total number of widgets produced.

\[ 150 \text{ widgets/hour} \times 8 \text{ hours/day} = 1200 \text{ widgets/day} \]

[/REASONING]

[ANSWER]
B
[/ANSWER]
